_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
Stopping a floating recording submits it to its original conversation without touching the viewed composer. The test seeded the conversation {{ORIGINAL}} at /c/{{ORIGINAL_SLUG}} and another conversation {{VIEWED}} at /c/{{VIEWED_SLUG}}. The page fakes the microphone, screen capture and MediaRecorder, and window.__recordingMock counts what the page asked for (read it with eval, e.g. "window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts"): displayRequests (screen captures requested), synchronousDisplayRequests (those requested inside a click or keydown handler), microphoneRequests, audioSources, recorderStarts, recorderStops and stoppedTracks (media tracks stopped). "The recording state" is the data-state attribute of ".recording-status". To "select conversation X from the drawer": if the button with aria-label "Open conversations" is visible, click it; then wait for ".conversation-item[data-conversation-id=\"X\"]" to be visible, click it, and wait until it has the class "active". The recorder "floats" while the recording panel is inside a [data-testid="recording-floating"] element: count '[data-testid="recording-floating"] [data-testid="recording-panel"]' (1 when floating, 0 when not). To "paste file F": eval window.__pasteFile(F), passing contents C and type T as further arguments only when the step names them, which pastes such a file into the message input; then wait until exactly one ".message-attachment-ready" exists. Attachment uploads (POST /api/upload) answer with the path /tmp/shelley-uploads/viewed-draft.txt. Recording uploads (POST /api/upload/raw) answer with /tmp/shelley-uploads/floating.webm, and call "uploads" counts them. Message submissions are accepted without being sent on; call "chats" counts them, and call "submissions" lists them as JSON, each with its URL path, message, model, and whether its body has a transcription_context property. The message input is [data-testid="message-input"], the voice button [data-testid="voice-button"], the recording panel [data-testid="recording-panel"], and its stop, cancel and retry buttons [data-testid="recording-stop-button"], [data-testid="recording-cancel-button"] and [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. When a step says an element should contain or have some text, assert that on that element, not with a page-wide wait_text. Perform the steps in order. 
1. Navigate to /c/{{ORIGINAL_SLUG}} and wait up to 30s for the message input to be visible. Fill it with "Original spoken context.".
2. Click the voice button. [data-testid="recording-status"] should have the text exactly "Recording…".
3. Select conversation {{VIEWED}} from the drawer. Fill the message input with "Do not disturb this viewed draft.". Paste file "viewed-draft.txt".
4. The voice button should be disabled, and the recorder should float.
5. Click the stop button. Call "chats" should return "1". No recording panel should remain (count 0).
6. Call "submissions" must return exactly [{"path":"/api/conversation/{{ORIGINAL}}/chat","message":"/transcription /tmp/shelley-uploads/floating.webm\nOriginal spoken context.","model":"predictable","transcription_context":false}].
7. Call "uploads" must return "1".
8. The URL should end with "/c/{{VIEWED_SLUG}}", and the message input should have the value "Do not disturb this viewed draft.".
9. The ".message-attachment-name" should have the text exactly "viewed-draft.txt", and exactly one ".message-attachment-ready" should exist.
